caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair and a detail view of its armrest within a square border set against a beige background. The chair is made of medium to dark brown wood with turned legs, stretchers, and spindles forming the backrest, which comprises both vertical spindles and a curved top rail. The seat is constructed with woven material, depicted in greenish-brown hues. The rockers are curved and attached to the bottom of the legs, while the armrests have a gentle curve, with the left armrest shown in greater detail above and to the left of the chair. The composition centers the chair within the outlined square, and the colors used are primarily natural wood tones and muted greens.
title: Rocking Chair
